inspectedFailure.sentinelMeaning: not found by rank 32; not rank 33
inspectedFailure.architecturalDiagnosis: The lexical cascade puts every fuzzy candidate in tier 2 and graph-only evidence in tier 3, allowing weak fuzzy candidates to precede a directly linked support record.

researchQuestion: On already-inspected development data, can an admission-bounded lexical-anchor and one-hop evidence-bundle method recover linked evidence missed by admission-first v2 and admitted BM25 without weakening temporal, repository, retention, disclosure, authority, supersession, conflict, citation, or mutation controls?

prohibitedDevelopmentReads: the deterministic 40-task agent sample as an evaluation population

queryEntityExtraction.backtickScan: ASCII backtick pairs left-to-right without nesting; ignore unmatched or spans above 256 UTF-16 code units
queryEntityExtraction.camelBoundary: between Unicode lowercase letter or number and a following uppercase letter
queryEntityExtraction.delimiterReplacement: replace each run of slash, dot, underscore, or hyphen with one ASCII space
queryEntityExtraction.zeroAdmittedDocumentFrequency: exclude from ranking entities; retain only in unmatched diagnostics
queryEntityExtraction.selection: highest admitted-title-body corpus IDF first, then JavaScript default string order

outputContract.graphMethodPathDiagnostics: all canonical, alternate, suppressed-duplicate, and self-loop paths

researchMethod.outputLimitBehavior: Bound outputLimit by admitted current event count. More than 1000 admitted current events is a retained output-limit failure; never widen after outcomes.

bm25.averageDocumentLength: sum retained title/body lexeme counts including duplicates divided by N; use 1 when N is 0
bm25.termFrequency: retained duplicate count in the event title/body
bm25.documentFrequency: admitted-current documents containing the term at least once
bm25.titleBoost: 1.8 exactly when the retained query term occurs in the tokenized title; otherwise 1
bm25.aggregation: sum termScore over query terms; zero-tf terms contribute zero

fuzzy.ngramConstruction: set of every consecutive JavaScript slice of length 3
fuzzy.similarity: set Jaccard; zero when either set is empty

graph.enumerationTiming: enumerate every allowed outgoing and incoming path for all anchors before deduplication or assignment
graph.selfLoopBehavior: retain as self-loop diagnostic only; never consume fanout or create output occurrence
pathSortOrder: relation type by JavaScript default string order
graph.multiAnchorAssignment: assign neighbor to first path in canonical path order
graph.anchorEmittedAsEarlierNeighborBehavior: suppress only the anchor's second output occurrence; still process all assigned neighbors
graph.duplicateSuppressionTiming: at start of each anchor turn before greedy ordering/fanout, then at every later channel append
graph.alreadyEmittedAssignedNeighborBehavior: assignment suppressed-duplicate; no fanout capacity, entity/provenance coverage, bundleLocalRank, or overflowLocalRank
graph.selfLoopBehaviorAfterAssignment: assignment self-loop; no fanout capacity or local rank
graph.anchorCoverageWhenAlreadyEmitted: anchor still supplies initial bundle entity and provenance coverage

distinct non-null provenanceSourceId before already represented source; null earns no diversity
direct admitted BM25 rank ascending with no rank last
relation type by JavaScript default string order

researchMethod.deduplication: exact event ID only; first output occurrence wins
bundleOrder: process anchors in admitted BM25 order
emit anchor only if not already global-emitted but always process its turn
suppress self-loops and already-emitted assigned neighbors before ordering without consuming capacity
emit first eight eligible unique ordered completion neighbors
preserve additional completion neighbors in overflow
after all bundles append remaining positive BM25 records
append zero-score records by timestamp descending then tieKey ascending

pathDiagnosticSemantics.promoted: canonical eligible unique neighbor in bundleLocalRank 1..8; overflowLocalRank null
pathDiagnosticSemantics.overflow: canonical eligible unique neighbor after first eight; bundleLocalRank null; overflowLocalRank one-based
pathDiagnosticSemantics.alternate: non-canonical path; both local ranks null
pathDiagnosticSemantics.suppressedDuplicate: canonical assigned neighbor already emitted before bundle fanout; both local ranks null and no capacity consumed
pathDiagnosticSemantics.selfLoop: self-loop diagnostic only; both local ranks null and no capacity consumed
pathDiagnosticSemantics.outputRank: neighbor final one-based full-permutation rank including another channel; null only for invalid method output
pathDiagnosticSemantics.overflowEmittedByEarlierBm25Channel: retain overflow assignment/local rank, record earlier outputRank, suppress later overflow append

oneHopComparatorNeighborOrder: direct BM25 rank ascending with no rank last
relation type by JavaScript default string order

ablationMechanics.noGraph: construct no path, bundle, fanout, or overflow; emit positive BM25, fuzzy-only, then zero-score channels

ablationMechanics.noProvenance: remove only neighbor tuple field 2 and replace provenanceSourceId with null in method adapter

renderingAndAccounting.oracleTiming: Seal and hash every full ordering before loading required identities or scoring evidence-complete prefixes.

budgetPacking.initialFrame: common framing, query, and current sources with zero events
budgetPacking.fitTest: render complete candidate frame then require ceil(frame.length / 4) <= budget
budgetPacking.firstNonFittingBehavior: stop; do not skip to a later record

secondaryCompactRenderer.futureHumanGate: Two method-blinded reviewers must confirm preservation on future confirmation data.
secondaryCompactRenderer.failureBehavior: No compact-efficiency conclusion and no rerun with outcome-informed longer spans.

metrics: runtime excluding corpus download and index construction

metricDefinitions.requiredEvidenceSetForPrefix: positive set exactly; never a method-specific subset
metricDefinitions.rankPositionRule: unknown IDs and every occurrence after an ID's first occurrence have grade zero and consume their output positions; uniqueness is applied only when forming retrieval sets
metricDefinitions.recallAtK: |unique known IDs in the first k output positions intersect positive set| / |positive set|
metricDefinitions.directRecallAtK: |unique known IDs in first k output positions intersect direct set| / |direct set|; null when direct set empty
metricDefinitions.hitAtK: 1 when unique known IDs in first k output positions intersect positive set, otherwise 0; null when positive set empty
metricDefinitions.mrr: 1 / minimum one-based rank of a positive; 0 when absent by full output limit 1000
metricDefinitions.dcgAt10: sum((2^grade_i - 1) / log2(i + 1), i=1..10); unknown and repeated-after-first IDs have grade 0 and consume position
metricDefinitions.idcgAt10: sort the complete sanitized event set by grade descending and tieKey ascending, then apply DCG@10

citationValidity.numerator: returned items whose ID occurs exactly once in sanitized input and whose returned event hash equals sanitized event hash
citationValidity.denominator: every returned item including duplicate or unknown IDs

supersessionPrecision.numerator: returned members of frozen supersession components marked current by evaluator-owned supersession oracle
supersessionPrecision.denominator: returned members of any frozen supersession component

redundancy.formula: 1 - distinct contentKey count / returned item count

exposure.forbiddenSet: frozen post-order exact eventId/eventHash pairs excluded for future, expiry, restriction, wrong repository, or supersession
exposure.futureSet: forbidden-set subset not strictly before asOf
exposure.count: returned occurrence count whose exact pair is in the set; duplicates count per occurrence
exposure.unknownIdBehavior: invalid citation, never silently assign to forbidden or future set

metricDefinitions.queryMacro: arithmetic mean over positive queries for recall, hit, MRR, and nDCG; direct recall uses only queries with non-empty direct set
metricDefinitions.microRecall: sum retrieved positive counts / sum positive counts
metricDefinitions.microDirectRecall: sum retrieved direct counts / sum direct counts
metricDefinitions.microHit: sum Hit@k over positive queries / positive query count
metricDefinitions.mrrAndNdcgMicroNaming: no event-level micro value; report query-macro MRR and query-macro nDCG
metricDefinitions.repositoryRecall: summed retrieved-positive count / summed positive count inside repository; direct uses analogous direct counts
metricDefinitions.repositoryHitMrrNdcg: arithmetic mean of eligible per-query values inside repository
metricDefinitions.repositoryCitationAndSupersession: sum item numerators / sum item denominators inside repository
metricDefinitions.repositoryRedundancy: arithmetic mean of per-query redundancy including empty output
metricDefinitions.repositoryMacro: unweighted arithmetic mean of repository values with non-zero metric denominator; redundancy includes every repository with at least one query
metricDefinitions.overallCitationAndSupersessionMicro: sum corresponding item numerators / sum corresponding item denominators

noPositiveAndFailureRules.abstainedAtBudget: 1 exactly when zero events are packed; otherwise 0
noPositiveAndFailureRules.unnecessaryContextAtBudget: max(0, packed-frame portable estimated tokens - zero-event-frame portable estimated tokens)
noPositiveAndFailureRules.correctAbstentionAggregate: arithmetic mean of abstainedAtBudget over every no-positive query
noPositiveAndFailureRules.unnecessaryContextAggregate: sum and arithmetic mean over every no-positive query
noPositiveAndFailureRules.timeoutStart: immediately before pure ranker invocation in a fresh evaluator worker
noPositiveAndFailureRules.timeoutEnforcement: terminate the fresh evaluator worker, discard partial ranking, and preserve raw failure observation

positiveMethodFailureMetrics.directRecall: 0 when direct set non-empty; null when direct set empty

noPositiveMethodFailureMetrics.aggregateBehavior: report failure count and block unnecessary-context aggregate

statistics.tokenDifferenceDirection: Qarinah tokens minus comparator tokens; negative favors Qarinah
statistics.nullOrIncompletePrefixBehavior: block token bootstrap and ratio gates; never impute
statistics.repositoryOrder: JavaScript default string order over frozen positive-population repository IDs
statistics.indexEncoding: unsigned base-10 ASCII without leading zeros
statistics.drawIndex: unsigned big-endian integer from first 8 hash bytes modulo repository count
statistics.tokenReplicateStatistic: sum multiplicity(repo(q)) * (Qarinah tokens - comparator tokens) / sum multiplicity(repo(q)) over every positive task

tokenHolm.sort: p ascending; comparator ID by JavaScript default string order breaks exact p ties
tokenHolm.rankThreshold: 0.05 / (m - i + 1) for one-based Holm rank i

recallNonInferiority.replicateComputation: compute both ratios from the same drawn repository multiset, preserving multiplicity in retrieved-direct and direct-label counts, then subtract comparator from Qarinah
recallNonInferiority.repositoryPopulation: repositories containing at least one task with non-empty direct set

statistics.microTokenReduction: 1 - sum positive-task Qarinah prefix tokens / sum positive-task comparator prefix tokens
statistics.repositoryTokenReduction: 1 - sum repository Qarinah prefix tokens / sum repository comparator prefix tokens
statistics.repositoryMacroTokenReduction: unweighted arithmetic mean of repository token-reduction ratios over all repositories with positive tasks
